content: {"praised":["Jennifer Saunders delivers dry wit and sharp satire","The show is a dark, black comedy about reality TV","Humor is campy, with clever pratfalls and witty dialogue","The cast is brilliant and supports the lead well","Each episode stands alone yet works best in sequence"],"criticized":["Premise feels flat and fails to deliver laughs","Subplot about Viv's marriage lacks development","Lacks the expected campy energy and moxy","Excessive use of profanity detracts from enjoyment","Overall execution is disappointing and poorly paced"]}
